brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 2048x1152 pixels preferred. It must be an expressive hand-drawn ink-and-brush illustration, emphatically NOT a photograph or photorealistic render.

Use the approved black/lime thumbnail previously inspected in this conversation only as a STYLE reference: near-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory lettering, vigorous dry-brush textures and energetic ink hatching, few elements, extremely bold Japanese typography. Do not carry over that sample's player, name, date, score, composition, or performance claims.

SUBJECT: One real basketball player, Brandon Randolph (ブランドン・ランドルフ), based on the B.LEAGUE official portrait inspected in this conversation (https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/704/2026-27/51000643_03.png). His distinctive features must be recognizable: neat tight black cornrow braids swept back with visible scalp partings and short closely clipped sides; elongated oval face with high cheekbones and tapered jaw; arched dark eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes; broad smiling mouth in the reference but use a focused, calm playing expression here; thin mustache, fine short jawline beard and a darker pointed chin goatee; warm medium-brown skin, long lean athletic frame. Keep the face readable in the ink illustration, not silhouetted. Left shoulder/upper arm has dark tattoo shading, but no lettering in tattoos. A plain ivory sleeveless jersey with dark edges and plain dark basketball shorts; NO team branding, NO jersey number, NO sponsors, NO logo, NO player name.

COMPOSITION: Player dominates the LEFT 43% of the image, in a low forward-driving three-quarter stance, torso twisting slightly toward the viewer, one hand controlling an orange basketball near waist/hip level and the other arm bent naturally for balance. Face, both hands, ball and upper legs entirely visible and anatomically plausible. Keep fingers distinct, arms connected correctly. This is an imagined generic dribbling action, NOT a depiction of any documented game moment. No other players, no scoreboard, no audience, no photomontage. Abstract lime brush sweeps behind him convey movement. RIGHT 55% is a clean bold typography block with ample separation from the figure and strong thumbnail readability.

TEXT: Render ONLY the following exact Japanese strings, with no additional visible text:
Top-right, medium bold ivory: "11/12 試合結果"
Middle-right, very large ivory: "公式記録の"
Immediately below, the largest lime type: "確定待ち"
Below headline, small but clearly readable ivory: "2026.11.12 19:07 JST時点"
Bottom-right, legible ivory labels on a quiet black strip: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "イメージ"

Editorial meaning: the fixed source article states all official game records are awaiting confirmation as of 2026-11-12 19:07 JST. Do not imply final results or participation. Randolph was randomly selected from ten names in the article only to provide a real-person illustration. Never show his name, points, statistics, award, participation or performance claims. Do not use "成績をもとにしたイメージ"; the label must be simply "イメージ". Do not add EFF, scores, other dates or names.
Maintain a 5% safe margin for every text element. Avoid cropped ball/hands/head, extra limbs, malformed fingers, logos and photographic textures. Finish as one polished thumbnail.
